about_the_game:
Rok Match - Supporter Pack

Optional DLC that serves as a way to thank the author for their hard work.

You will get:

  • Access to the "Extras" section in the launcher, where you can tweak additional settings, such as skipping the start page in the launcher to go directly to multiplayer or changing/disabling the startup screen in single-player mode. For example, you can set "Expansion Pak Found" as the startup screen!

  • Start with the Talon weapon in multiplayer (along with the default War Blade). This is a very weak and mostly useless weapon, but it can be used for fun. It also has its own unique killstring!

  • Access to a mini-log containing some development history.

content_descriptors.notes: This game have content not appropriate for all ages: Frequent Violence or Gore, General Mature Content.
